tasks.build:dev:prep: deno eval 'const p="./build/dev/bundle.ts"; const c=await Deno.readTextFile(p); await Deno.writeTextFile(p, "const __DEV__ = true;\n" + c);'
tasks.build:release:prep: deno eval 'const p="./build/release/bundle.ts"; const c=await Deno.readTextFile(p); await Deno.writeTextFile(p, "const __DEV__ = false;\n" + c);'
tasks.build: mkdir -p dist/release/ build/release/ && cp -r manifest.json src/styles/ vendor/ dist/release/ && deno bundle -o ./build/release/bundle.ts ./src/content.ts && deno task build:release:prep && deno transpile -o dist/release/content.js ./build/release/bundle.ts
tasks.build:dev: deno task clean:dev && mkdir -p dist/dev/ build/dev/ && cp -r manifest.json src/styles/ vendor/ dist/dev/  && deno bundle -o ./build/dev/bundle.ts ./src/content.ts && deno task build:dev:prep && deno transpile -o dist/dev/content.js ./build/dev/bundle.ts
